newsitem.title: USA: CDI names Mitch Wienick Pres/CEO.
newsitem.headline: CDI names Mitch Wienick Pres/CEO.

text.p: CDI Corp said Wednesday it elected Mitch Wienick, 48, as CSI's new president and chief executive officer, effective April 7.
Wienick is currently president of Ameritech Consumer Services, the largest business unit of Ameritech Corp.
Walter Garrison, CDI's current president, CEO and board chairman will, at age 71, retire from active involvement with the company, it said.
Garrison will remain as board chairman but will have no executive management responsibilities, the company said.
Wienick will also join CDI's board, effective April 7, the company said.
